title: Virtual Card Management: Single-Use vs Multi-Use Virtual Cards
summary: This document explains when to use Virtual Card single-use vs multi-use cards. Single-use cards are available for one-time purchases/trials and invalidate after one authorization; multi-use cards rotate the number on a monthly schedule for recurring purchases/subscriptions, and it provides setup tips for maintaining a pool and documenting refresh cadence.
